title: A seeded train and test split
summary: Shuffle a list with a seed and split it into train and test parts, with checks on sizes, overlap and repeatability.

mutants.no_clamp: Does not keep at least one item in each part, so a small test fraction gives an empty test set.
mutants.ignores_seed: Makes a new random generator without the seed, so two calls give different splits.
mutants.shuffles_in_place: Shuffles the caller's list, so the input changes.
mutants.no_shuffle: Takes the first items as the test set and does not shuffle.
mutants.swapped_parts: Returns the test part first and the train part second.
